name: Personal Current Account Opening — Participant Interaction
description: Defines, for each phase of JRN-001, what each participant can see (data projection), what actions they can take (entitlements), and what communications they receive (notifications). Covers: PER-001 (Personal Customer), PER-052 (Compliance Officer / MLRO — exception and referral paths), PER-056 (Branch Staff — manual referral and eKYC fallback paths), PER-060 (IT Operations — provisioning failure exception path).

projection.description: Customer sees the account opening application form. Displayed fields: full name, date of birth, residential address, email address, phone number, nationality, account type selector (standard / packaged / switching). No account data exists yet — no balance, no account number.
data_fields_visible: Application reference (provisional, system-generated)
Account type options and associated features/fees
Eligibility criteria summary (age 18+, UK resident)
FSCS protection summary (£85,000 per depositor)
Packaged account monthly fee (if selected)
data_not_visible: System fraud signals being captured in background

actions_permitted: Complete and submit personal details form
Select account type
Upload or enter residential address
Save application progress and return later (session-bound, 24-hour expiry)
Abandon application
actions_not_permitted: View other customers' data
Modify system eligibility rules
Skip mandatory personal detail fields

notifications.content: Your application has been started. Reference: [application_ref]. We will guide you through a few more steps — it usually takes around 5–10 minutes.
It looks like you're under 18. We have a great account designed for young people — tap here to find out more.
notifications.timing: Immediate on date of birth entry

projection.description: Customer sees the document capture and biometric liveness check screens. Step-by-step guidance is provided for document type selection, camera capture, and selfie/liveness instructions. Progress indicator shows step 2 of 5.
data_fields_visible: Accepted document types (passport, UK driving licence, national identity card)
Step-by-step capture instructions
Liveness check animation instructions
Verification status: In Progress / Passed / Failed
Retry count (maximum 2 attempts)
data_fields_masked: Document number is not displayed back to the customer after capture
Biometric template — never transmitted or visible to customer
data_not_visible: Identity verification vendor name and scoring detail

actions_permitted: Select identity document type
Capture document via camera (mobile) or file upload (web)
Complete biometric liveness check
Retry document capture once after failure (maximum 2 attempts)
Switch to an alternative document type after first failure
Request branch appointment if digital identity verification cannot be completed
actions_not_permitted: Upload documents on behalf of another person
Bypass biometric liveness check
Proceed to next phase without completed verification

notifications.trigger: Document capture completed and under review
notifications.content: We are verifying your document — this usually takes a few seconds.
Identity confirmed. We are now completing a few background checks — please wait.
We could not verify that document. Please try again with a different document or ensure the image is clear.
We were unable to verify your identity online. We have booked you a branch appointment — details below. Alternatively, call us on [number].

projection.description: The customer sees a 'Checking your details' holding screen while automated KYC/CDD and sanctions screening complete. No KYC scoring detail or screening match information is surfaced to the customer. If the automated check takes longer than expected (e.g., EDD path), the customer sees an estimated wait time.
data_fields_visible: Progress indicator: 'Checking your details'
Estimated completion time if processing exceeds 30 seconds
Contact number for queries
data_not_visible: Whether a SAR is being considered (tipping-off prohibition — POCA 2002 s333A)
Specific data sources used for screening

actions_permitted: Wait for automated check completion
Close app and return (application state preserved for 48 hours)
Contact support for status update (support agents have limited visibility per tipping-off rules)
actions_not_permitted: View screening results
Modify any submitted identity or personal data during this phase
Proceed to next phase without system-generated outcome

notifications.trigger: KYC automated checks pass — CLEAR result
notifications.content: All checks completed. Reviewing your application now.

notifications.trigger: KYC checks require additional review (referral path)
notifications.content: We need a little more time to complete our checks. We will be in touch within 3 business days. Your application reference is [ref].

notifications.trigger: Sanctions hit — application blocked (no tipping off)
notifications.content: We are unable to open an account for you at this time. If you have questions, please contact us on [number] or write to [address].

projection.description: On approval, the customer sees a congratulatory confirmation screen showing their new account details (sort code and account number). On refer, they see a status screen with case reference and SLA. On decline, they see the decline notification with a generic reason and FOS signpost.
data_fields_visible: Decision outcome: Approved / Under Review / Declined
If Approved: account type, indicative features (overdraft availability, card delivery date)
If Under Review: case reference, SLA (up to 3 business days), contact details
If Declined: decline reason (generic — e.g., 'We are unable to open an account for you at this time'), FOS details, right to request a copy of the decision basis (subject to legal restrictions)
data_fields_masked: Specific KYC data points that contributed to decline
data_not_visible: Decision model weights or credit bureau scores used

actions_permitted: View approval confirmation and proceed to account setup
Download or email confirmation of approval decision
Request a manual review of a declined decision (where permitted by policy)
Contact FOS if dissatisfied with a decline decision (signpost provided)
If referred: upload additional documents requested by compliance team
actions_not_permitted: Appeal a sanctions-related decline directly (must go through OFSI/legal process)
Access the account before provisioning is complete

notifications.content: Congratulations — your account has been approved! We are setting it up now. You will be ready to bank in just a moment.
Your application is being reviewed by our team. We will update you within 3 business days. Reference: [case_ref].
We are sorry, we are unable to open an account for you at this time. If you have questions, you can contact the Financial Ombudsman Service at [FOS details]. Reference: [application_ref].

projection.description: The customer sees a loading/confirmation screen while provisioning completes (typically under 5 seconds). On success, they are shown their new sort code and account number. Card delivery date is confirmed.
data_fields_visible: Sort code (6 digits)
Account number (8 digits)
Account type name
Estimated card delivery date (3–5 working days)
FSCS protection confirmation statement

actions_permitted: Copy sort code and account number to clipboard
Share account details (within app) for salary redirection purposes
Download account confirmation PDF
actions_not_permitted: Initiate payments before digital channel activation is complete
Modify account number or sort code

notifications.content: Your account is ready. Sort code: [XX-XX-XX], Account number: [XXXXXXXX]. Your card is on its way — expected [date]. Your account is protected by the FSCS up to £85,000.
Your application was approved but we are experiencing a short delay setting up your account. We will complete this within [4 business hours] and email you when it is ready.
notifications.timing: Within 5 minutes of provisioning failure detection

projection.description: The customer sees the digital onboarding setup wizard. Steps: create online banking password, enrol biometric, register device, configure push notifications. Progress shown as a stepped indicator (e.g., '3 of 4 steps complete').
data_fields_visible: Online banking username (pre-filled from account setup, editable)
Password strength indicator
Biometric enrolment status: Not enrolled / Enrolled
Device name registered
Push notification preferences (transaction alerts, account updates, offers)
data_fields_masked: Biometric template (never displayed; processed on-device only)

actions_permitted: Set online banking password
Enrol biometric authentication factor
Register current device as primary SCA device
Configure push notification preferences
Skip biometric enrolment and use TOTP app instead
Defer notification setup and configure later in account settings
actions_not_permitted: Register more than 3 devices without additional verification
Disable SCA entirely
Access full account functionality before first-login SCA is confirmed

notifications.content: You are all set up! Welcome to [Bank Name]. Your account is ready to use.
We could not set up biometric login on this device. You can use our authenticator app instead — here is how.
A new device has been registered to your account. If this was not you, call us immediately on [fraud line].

projection.description: The customer sees the in-app welcome dashboard: account balance (£0.00), sort code and account number, card status ('on its way'), CASS switch prompt, initial funding prompt, and introductory product cards. Personalised based on account type selected at PH-001.
data_fields_visible: Account balance: £0.00
Sort code and account number
Card status and expected delivery date
FSCS information summary and link to full information sheet
CASS switch prompt (if applicable)
Initial funding methods (bank transfer, CASS)
Product cross-sell cards (savings account, overdraft availability, packaged account)

actions_permitted: View account details and balance
Initiate CASS switch from previous account
Make first deposit via bank transfer
Set up salary payment redirection
Apply for linked savings account (new product journey)
Express interest in overdraft facility (new journey)
Update notification preferences
Dismiss or defer product cross-sell cards
actions_not_permitted: Make outbound payments before first deposit (zero balance) unless overdraft is granted
Complete CASS switch before account provisioning is fully confirmed

notifications.content: Welcome to [Bank Name]! Your account is ready. Here are your details, your FSCS protection summary, and some tips to get started.

notifications.trigger: 3 days after account opening — no funding received
notifications.content: Your account is ready and waiting. Add your first payment by transferring funds or switching your account with our free CASS service.
notifications.timing: 72 hours post-account opening if balance remains £0.00

notifications.content: Your card is on its way! Expected delivery: [date]. You can use your card details in-app for online purchases before it arrives.
notifications.timing: On CardIssuanceTriggered confirmation from card processor

notifications.content: Your card should have arrived by now. If you have not received it, please let us know in-app and we will send a replacement.

participants.participation_scope: Active in AP-001 (Manual Referral / EDD), EX-001 (KYC Failure / SAR), EX-002 (Sanctions Hit). Not involved in the happy path.

phases.phase_name: KYC/CDD Assessment — Referral and Exception Handling

projection.description: The MLRO and compliance team see the full KYC case record in the case management system (SVC-014). This includes the complete customer identity data, screening results (PEP matches, sanctions hits, adverse media), risk score breakdown, the identity verification outcome from SVC-050, and the full application history.
data_fields_visible: Customer full name, date of birth, nationality, address
Application reference and timestamp
Identity verification outcome and confidence score (Onfido/Jumio result detail)
PEP screening result with match details (name, position, country, data source)
Sanctions screening result with match details (list name, match confidence, beneficial ownership chain)
Adverse media summary and source links
Customer risk tier (Low/Medium/High) with scoring factors
Previous application history (if any) for this identity
Internal suspicious activity disclosures linked to this application (where raised)
data_not_visible: Other customer accounts not relevant to the case

actions_permitted: Review full KYC case record
Request additional documentation from the customer via secure document request in SVC-014
Approve application following EDD completion (AP-001)
Decline application on compliance grounds
Escalate case to MLRO for PEP or sanctions sign-off
Raise internal SAR disclosure to MLRO (EX-001)
Initiate OFSI notification workflow (EX-002)
Add case notes and document review actions for audit trail
Override automated risk tier (with documented rationale)
Place tipping-off hold on customer communications
actions_not_permitted: Approve an application with an uncleared confirmed sanctions hit
Remove SAR from case management without MLRO sign-off
Access unrelated customer accounts without a documented case reason

notifications.channel: Internal case management system alert + Email
notifications.content: New KYC referral for review. Application: [ref]. Reason: [PEP identified / High risk score / Adverse media]. Target review SLA: 3 business days.
URGENT: Sanctions hit detected on application [ref]. Customer name: [name]. Match: [list name, confidence]. Account opening blocked. OFSI notification obligation: 14 days. MLRO review required.
Internal disclosure received for application [ref]. SAR decision required within 5 business days per POCA 2002 s330.
EDD case [ref] is approaching the 3-business-day customer SLA. Current status: [status]. Action required.

projection.description: For referred applications requiring MLRO or senior compliance sign-off, the compliance team see a decision approval screen showing the full EDD package: customer documentation, compliance officer review notes, EDD evidence, and the recommended decision.
data_fields_visible: Full EDD package including source of funds/wealth documentation
Compliance officer review notes and risk assessment
Recommended decision with rationale
Decision audit trail

actions_permitted: Approve application (MLRO sign-off for PEP cases)
Decline application with documented rationale
Return case to compliance officer for additional information
Document decision rationale in audit trail
actions_not_permitted: Approve a case with outstanding unresolved sanctions hit
Approve without documented EDD rationale

notifications.content: EDD case [ref] is ready for MLRO sign-off. All documentation received. Recommended decision: [Approve/Decline]. Please review.
notifications.timing: When compliance officer marks case as ready for MLRO review

participants.participation_scope: Active in AP-001 where customer is referred to branch for manual identity verification (eKYC fallback) or EDD document collection. Not involved in the happy path (digital-only).

projection.description: Branch staff access the Customer Onboarding Service (SVC-050) via the branch terminal (CH-004). They can see the customer's in-progress application record, the failed digital verification outcome, and the manual identity check checklist. Full customer personal data is visible for identity check purposes.
data_fields_visible: Customer application reference and status
Digital verification failure reason (document failure or system fallback — not fraud flag details)
Customer personal details as submitted in PH-001
Manual identity check checklist (document type, expiry, photo match, address confirmation)
Branch appointment booking details
data_fields_masked: Internal fraud scores (branch staff should not see fraud signals to avoid bias in customer interaction)
data_not_visible: Other customer accounts (unless separately authenticated by the customer in branch)

actions_permitted: Complete manual identity document check (document type, validity, photo comparison)
Confirm address from document or secondary evidence
Submit manual identity verification outcome to SVC-050
Collect additional EDD documentation from customer (for AP-001 cases)
Upload documentation securely to the case management system
Flag vulnerability indicators in customer record (FCA FG21/1)
Refer customer to specialist compliance team if additional concerns arise
actions_not_permitted: Override a compliance-placed fraud hold without compliance team authorisation
Access a customer application that is not linked to a branch referral
Complete an account opening without completing the full manual identity checklist

notifications.content: New branch referral for identity verification. Customer: [name], Application: [ref], Appointment time: [time]. Required documents: [list].
notifications.timing: When referral is created; repeated 30 minutes before scheduled appointment

notifications.content: Identity verified manually. Application [ref] has been updated. Customer may now complete remaining steps digitally or in branch.
notifications.timing: Immediate on submission of manual check outcome

notifications.content: Manual identity verification could not be completed for application [ref]. Reason: [documented reason]. Case referred to compliance team.

projection.description: Where the AP-001 path requires in-branch EDD document collection (e.g. source of funds evidence), branch staff see a document collection task in their branch terminal with the specific documents requested by the compliance team.
data_fields_visible: EDD document request list (e.g., payslips, bank statements, source of wealth declaration)
Case reference and compliance team contact
Document checklist status (received / outstanding)

actions_permitted: Receive and scan/upload EDD documents from customer
Mark document checklist items as received in case system
Advise customer on which documents are required (per compliance team list only)
actions_not_permitted: Make compliance judgements on document adequacy
Approve or decline the application
Discuss compliance concerns directly with the customer in terms that could constitute tipping off

notifications.trigger: EDD document collection task assigned to branch
notifications.content: EDD document collection required for application [ref]. Documents needed: [list]. Please assist customer when they attend branch.
notifications.timing: When compliance team assigns collection task

participants.participation_scope: Active only in EX-005 (Account Provisioning Failure). Monitors system health throughout the journey via the observability platform (SVC-112) but has no active role in the happy path or compliance paths.

projection.description: IT Operations see the provisioning failure alert in the observability platform (SVC-112), including the failed account provisioning event, error type, affected service (SVC-001), error timestamp, and current system health status.
data_fields_visible: Provisioning failure alert with error code and stack trace
Application reference (application_ref — not customer PII in alert)
Affected service: SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core)
Error type (sort code allocation failure / system timeout / duplicate account conflict)
System health dashboard: SVC-001 availability, error rate, queue depth
Number of applications affected by the same failure mode
Incident severity classification (P1/P2/P3 per PRA SS1/21 impact tolerance)
data_fields_masked: Customer full name, address, and PII (shown as application reference only in technical alerts)

actions_permitted: Acknowledge incident alert and assign to on-call engineer
Investigate SVC-001 logs and error trace
Trigger account provisioning retry for affected applications (after root cause identified)
Escalate to P1 incident process if SVC-001 availability is below impact tolerance threshold
Coordinate with core banking vendor for system-level issues
Trigger customer communication workflow to notify affected applicants of delay (via SVC-017 / SVC-053)
actions_not_permitted: Manually create account records directly in SVC-001 without approval workflow
Access or modify customer KYC or compliance records
Override sort code or account number allocation rules
Access customer authentication credentials

notifications.content: ALERT: AccountProvisioned event failure on SVC-001. Application refs affected: [count]. Error: [error_code]. Severity: [P1/P2/P3]. On-call engineer: please acknowledge.
notifications.timing: Within 2 minutes of failure detection by SVC-112

notifications.content: Provisioning failure resolved. [N] affected applications retried. [N] successful. Post-incident review scheduled.

notifications.trigger: SVC-001 availability below impact tolerance (PRA SS1/21)
notifications.content: CRITICAL: Account Opening Important Business Service — SVC-001 availability below [threshold]%. PRA SS1/21 impact tolerance breach. Escalate to CTO and SMF on-call.
